```notes
The search entry point's final conditional contains two preparatory tile loops, nested conditionals, a further tile loop and four output stores. It cannot be represented exactly using the supplied O0 epilogue rules: loop.tilex_O0 requires an epilogue-producing body, but the preparatory loops do not end in a store. The closest symbols considered were stmt.if_O0, loop.tilex_O0, loop.tilex_C0, block.seq4_O0 and store.cands_O0.

The chromosome above is a partial translation, not a verified exact equivalent. In particular, the final merge and output writes remain untranslatable in this representation.
```
